```yaml
name: Test BPFtrace Rust Uprobe Tutorial

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  test-rust-uprobe:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Install Rust toolchain
      uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
      with:
        toolchain: stable
        target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
        override: true

    - name: Install bpftrace
      run: |
        sudo apt-get update
        sudo apt-get install -y bpftrace

    - name: Build helloworld project in debug mode
      run: |
        cd examples/rust-uprobe/helloworld
        cargo build --debug
        ls -la target/debug/

    - name: Verify hello function symbol exists in helloworld
      run: |
        cd examples/rust-uprobe/helloworld
        objdump -t target/debug/helloworld | grep hello

    - name: Build args project in debug mode
      run: |
        cd examples/rust-uprobe/args
        cargo build --debug
        ls -la target/debug/

    - name: Verify hello function symbol exists in args
      run: |
        cd examples/rust-uprobe/args
        objdump -t target/debug/args | grep hello

    - name: Test args binary execution
      run: |
        cd examples/rust-uprobe/args
        timeout 5s ./target/debug/args || true

    - name: Test bpftrace attach to helloworld with wildcard pattern
      run: |
        cd examples/rust-uprobe/helloworld
        timeout 10s bpftrace -e 'uprobe:./target/debug/helloworld:"_ZN10helloworld5hello*" { printf("Hello called\n"); }' &
        sleep 2
        ./target/debug/helloworld
        sleep 1

    - name: Test bpftrace attach to args with wildcard pattern
      run: |
        cd examples/rust-uprobe/args
        timeout 10s bpftrace -e 'uprobe:./target/debug/args:"_ZN4args5hello*" { printf("Args hello called\n"); }' &
        sleep 2
        ./target/debug/args
        sleep 1
```
